name: hinglish-before-after-saas-hook
description: Encodes the "Pehle vs Ab" (Before vs After) creative pattern for Indian B2B/SaaS vertical video ads targeting urban Indian professionals. The hook opens with a hyper-relatable late-night struggle moment spoken in Hinglish, cuts to a dramatic VS split card, then reveals the product solving the pain in seconds — closing with a soft spoken CTA plus an on-screen pill button. Trigger this skill whenever the brief involves an Indian professional audience (CAs, lawyers, HR managers, doctors, fintech us
author: Official
